records.deidentified_narrative: unit 3, a pedestrian, was walking eastbound in the northbound lanes of n. central expressway (us75). unit 3 failed to yield the right of way to unit 1 [roadway] from [roadway] and collided with unit 1's front concentrated. the force of this collision redirected unit 3 in a northwesterly direction and came to final rest approximately 120 feet north from the area of impact. unit 3 died from injuries sustained from this collision. the crash scene and all interviews were recorded on a body-worn camera. the video and/or photographs were saved to evidence. com on id# 22-2294782. a 3d laser scan of the crash scene was not completed due to the rain. the on-call vehicle crimes unit detective was notified and came out and took photos of the scene. this report is incomplete pending blood toxicology for unit 3. this is traffic fatality 151 for the city of dallas for the year 2022. see related # [phone]. this report was supplemented to add unit 3's toxicology which showed amphetamine: 33. 2 +/-2. 5 ng/ml and methamphetamine: 1110. 2 +/-83. 3 ng/ml. this report is now complete.

records.deidentified_narrative: u2 (pedestrian) stated he was walking onto the crosswalk from the sidewalk, heading sb at the intersection of oakwell farms/harry wurzbach. u2 stated he had the ""go"" to walk across the crosswalk. u2 stated as he began to walk across the crosswalk u1 approached the intersection, heading wb on oakwell farms to turn right onto nb harry wurzbach. u2 stated u1 driver was looking to his left at oncoming traffic and then slowly rolled forward and began turning right without looking right for pedestrians. as u1 rolled forward he bumped into u2 with the passenger side of his vehicle, causing u2 to fall to the ground. u2 states he was able to return to a standing position and u1 stopped to render aid. u2 stated u1 driver then asked to transport u2 and u3(wife of u2) to an alternate location for safety. u1 then transported u2 and u3 to a church. u2 stated he called police from the alternate location but police never showed up. u2 then stated he called the police non-emergency number and was told by a service agent that he could call later to make the report over the phone. u2 stated he then took an uber home and called police later for the report. u1 driver made a report with officer morris #0391 at the time of the incident, prior to u2 making this report. reference sapd22269098. u1 driver stated as he approached the listed intersection, traveling eb on oakwell farms towards the intersection, he observed u2 fall to his knees in the crosswalk, but is unsure if he actually hit u2. u1 driver neither confirmed nor denied if he struck u2. u1 then transported u2 and u3 to the alternate location, church, to safely exchange information and wait for police arrival. u1 stated neither u1 nor u2 exchanged information at this time. u1 stated u2 then took an uber from the alternate location before police arrival. u1 stayed at the location and gave his statement to responding officer morris #0391. officer morris #0391 stated there did not appear to be any damage to u1 upon his observation of u1's vehicle. u2 was checked by ems and medically cleared. u2 did complain of soreness to the left side of his body claiming possible injury. i did not observe any visible injury to u2. u2 was provided a [case id] and sapd form 12-dar.
